rules.text: Priest's Pack contains: 1 × Backpack, 1 × Blanket, 1 × Holy Water, 1 × Lamp, 7 × Rations, 1 × Robe, 1 × Tinderbox.

authored_operations: Grant the listed quantities exactly once from the selected class package. Resolve actual item copies/units, including sheets, days and flasks. Do not grant a priced shell in addition to free duplicate contents.

Pack is a purchase/grant bundle, not a promise that everything fits inside its Backpack. Preserve source bundle weight separately from measured contents; do not force all contents into the 30-pound compartment or invent unknown weights.
A Scholar pack Book has no specified topic or accuracy. Retain unknown metadata; grant no topic bonus merely for possession.

definition.name: Priest's Pack
definition.description: Backpack, blanket, Holy Water, lamp, seven days of Rations, robe, and tinderbox. Carried as one bundle.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Resolve six complete pack lists and exact once-only expansion. Existing three pack seeds are partial reuse. Shell versus contents and actual storage must not duplicate gear or pretend bundle contents fit the Backpack.
